# zillizcloud_service_account_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists all matching Service Account API key metadata. Secrets are never returned. Automatically reads all pages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zillizcloud_service_account_api_keys" "existing" {
  service_account_id = "sa-example"
  name               = "ingestion"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_account_id` (String) Owning Service Account ID.

### Optional

- `api_key_id` (String) Substring filter for the API key ID.
- `name` (String) Substring filter for the name.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Matching records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `total_count` (Number) Number of returned items.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) Creation time in UTC ISO 8601 format.
- `created_by` (String) Creator identifier.
- `creator_name` (String) Creator display name.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `expire_time` (String) Expiration time in UTC ISO 8601 format, or null.
- `id` (String) API key ID.
- `name` (String) Key name.
- `service_account_id` (String) Owning Service Account ID.
